term.income.name: Income
term.income.life: Your uncle gives ₹500 at Diwali; that's money in.
term.income.real: Income = money you receive, from pocket money, a job, a gift or a scholarship.
term.expense.name: Expense
term.expense.real: Expense = money that goes out. Fixed: same each time. Variable: changes.
term.need.name: Need
term.need.simple: Something you must have to live and study.
term.want.name: Want
term.want.simple: Something nice you could live without.
term.want.life: Branded sneakers, a movie with friends.
term.want.real: Want = a non-essential you'd like. Wants are fine when planned.
term.fixedExpense.name: Fixed expense
term.fixedExpense.simple: An expense that stays the same each time, like a bus pass.
term.variableExpense.name: Variable expense
term.variableExpense.simple: An expense that changes, like snacks and outings.
term.goal.name: Goal
term.goal.simple: A want with a price and a date.
term.goal.life: "A ₹3,000 laptop bag by Month 6" is a goal.
term.goal.real: Goal = a specific thing you save for, with an amount and a deadline.
term.opportunityCost.name: Opportunity cost
term.opportunityCost.simple: What you give up when you choose one thing over another.
term.opportunityCost.life: Spend ₹1,200 on a trip and that ₹1,200 can't go to your laptop bag.
term.opportunityCost.real: Opportunity cost = what you give up: the other thing that money could have done.
term.budget.name: Budget
term.budget.simple: A plan for your money before you spend it.
term.budget.life: ₹4,000 arrives: ₹1,600 to savings first, ₹2,400 for wants.
term.budget.real: Budget = a plan that splits income into savings and spending ahead of time.
term.payYourselfFirst.name: Pay yourself first
term.payYourselfFirst.simple: Put savings aside as soon as money arrives, then spend the rest.
term.fiftyThirtyTwenty.simple: A guide: about 50% for needs, 30% for wants, 20% for savings.
term.fiftyThirtyTwenty.life: In Capito needs are covered, so the 30 and 20 become 60% wants and 40% savings.
term.fiftyThirtyTwenty.real: 50-30-20 rule = a rough budget guide, not a law. Adjust it to your life.
term.savingsRate.name: Savings rate
term.savingsRate.simple: The share of your money that you save.
term.savingsRate.life: Save ₹1,600 out of ₹4,000 and your savings rate is 40%.
term.savingsRate.real: Savings rate = money saved ÷ money received × 100.
term.asset.name: Asset
term.asset.simple: Something you own that has value.
term.asset.life: Money in savings, a cycle, gold earrings.
term.asset.real: Asset = anything you own that is worth money.
term.liability.name: Liability
term.liability.life: A phone loan you are repaying, or ₹500 borrowed from a friend.
term.liability.real: Liability = a debt you must pay back.
term.netWorth.name: Net worth
term.netWorth.simple: What you own minus what you owe.
term.netWorth.life: Own ₹60,000 and owe ₹10,000: your net worth is ₹50,000.
term.depreciation.name: Depreciation
term.depreciation.simple: Losing value as something gets older.
term.depreciation.life: A ₹6,000 phone is worth about ₹5,020 after 6 months.
term.depreciation.real: Depreciation = the fall in an item's value over time, often a % each year.
